provenance.sourcePolicy: Complete unmodified upstream source; Node stripTypeScriptTypes removes types only; no extracted/copied/reimplemented services logic.

markers.$undefined: An actual JavaScript undefined, including explicitly present SDK option keys.
markers.$handle: Opaque object/function identity, NOT serialized production implementation. Input handles declares shape; configs use config:<entry key>; natives use native:<entry key>.
markers.queueArray: ordinary#N/native#N names are assigned by WeakMap identity. Array replacement and append are distinct observable events.

seams: config.getAgentDir is an explicit memory constant, not the real config.ts environment/package resolver.
Both services.ts and utils/paths.ts execute in a VM with controlled process.cwd/platform, empty env, and homedir; node:path uses the genuine requested Node platform implementation.
ModelRuntime/SettingsManager/DefaultResourceLoader are in-memory collaborators; runtime create, reload and refresh contain microtask waits; no catalog/auth/resource I/O executes.

Provider registration callbacks perform only input-declared append/filter/throw effects. Queue iteration, clearing, error collection, flag validation and construction sequencing are exclusively upstream services code.
Native objects and callbacks retain actual JS identity; native stream is fail-closed and never invoked. This does not validate native provider streaming.
SDK createAgentSession is an explicit forwarding spy returning an opaque memory result. This validates the services adapter, not SDK/AgentSession end-to-end behavior.

Path canonicalization/stat, child process calls, non-allowlisted imports and network access are unavailable/fail-closed inside the VM. Filesystem access outside it is limited to reading source/input/driver files for this capture.
Queue filter is a collaborator's replacement of the queue property; the original for-of array iterator remains authoritative. This must not be normalized to a mutable single-list algorithm.

cases.note: Input entries instantiate a real Map: duplicate keys keep first insertion position and last value.
getAgentDir is a controlled collaborator; its return is not passed back through resolvePath by services.
Adversarial JS caller includes Omit-reserved keys; upstream spread must still override them.
JavaScript nullish-coalescing boundary; null is not in the nominal TS option type.

Ordinary items queued in the native group survive; upstream does not run a second ordinary pass.
